0.name: TEXT_VOICEMAN_04004_000010_ALPHINAUD
0.description: If all are in agreement, I will outline my plan to retake Doma Castle.

1.name: TEXT_VOICEMAN_04004_000020_ALPHINAUD
1.description: First, Lyse and the Doman irregulars will conduct a series of raids against imperial targets throughout the surrounding area, with the aim of drawing the garrison's attention.

2.name: TEXT_VOICEMAN_04004_000030_ALPHINAUD
2.description: Shortly thereafter, our Xaela allies will launch a surprise attack on the castle's airborne defenses.

3.name: TEXT_VOICEMAN_04004_000040_ALPHINAUD
3.description: In this way, we will prevent the enemy's airships from rendering support, and cut off one means of escape.

4.name: TEXT_VOICEMAN_04004_000050_ALPHINAUD
4.description: Alisaie and I, together with the shinobi, will exploit the ensuing chaos to infiltrate the Moon Gates and disable the magitek field generators.

5.name: TEXT_VOICEMAN_04004_000060_ALPHINAUD
5.description: Once the barrier is down, we will be free to cross the One River and reach Doma Castle. It is at this point that we must turn to our Confederate and<hex:02100103>Kojin allies.

6.name: TEXT_VOICEMAN_04004_000070_ALPHINAUD
6.description: They will commence to bombard the castle with cannon fire, while sailing west towards the Doman Enclave.

7.name: TEXT_VOICEMAN_04004_000080_LYSE
7.description: Wait, the enclave? Why would you want them to sail away from the castle?

8.name: TEXT_VOICEMAN_04004_000090_ALPHINAUD
8.description: Because the enclave is home to countless civilians.

9.name: TEXT_VOICEMAN_04004_000100_ALPHINAUD
9.description: Once pressed, the imperials may well think to take them hostage, and I would fain forestall any such attempt.

10.name: TEXT_VOICEMAN_04004_000110_ALPHINAUD
10.description: After we have secured the enclave, we may lay siege to Doma Castle directly. The main strength of the Doman Liberation Front, under Lord Hien's command, shall be committed to this endeavor, as will you and your redoubtable allies.

11.name: TEXT_VOICEMAN_04004_000120_ALPHINAUD
11.description: The rest is simple. We scour the castle for the viceroy, we find her, and we subdue her. Without their leader, what remains of the imperials' morale will crumble, and they will surrender or attempt to flee. And Doma will be free.

12.name: TEXT_VOICEMAN_04004_000130_ALPHINAUD
12.description: Your thoughts, Lord Hien? If any points were unclear or gave you cause for concern, I should be glad to go over them with you.

13.name: TEXT_VOICEMAN_04004_000140_HIEN
13.description: Nay, 'tis a fine plan. You have a talent for this, that much is plain.

14.name: TEXT_VOICEMAN_04004_000150_HIEN
14.description: We shall carry out Alphinaud's plan to the letter. Time is of the essence, as you know, so let us each see to our respective preparations. Carry on!

15.name: TEXT_VOICEMAN_04004_000160_ALISAIE
15.description: May I present the Blue Kojin's emissary.

16.name: TEXT_VOICEMAN_04004_000170_SOROBAN
16.description: Greetings and well met, old friends! The elder sends his regards.

17.name: TEXT_VOICEMAN_04004_000180_LYSE
17.description: Soroban! It's good to have you with us!

18.name: TEXT_VOICEMAN_04004_000190_HIEN
18.description: If, uh, you might humor me...

19.name: TEXT_VOICEMAN_04004_000200_HIEN
19.description: Thank you for coming, Soroban. Doubtless you have already been informed of our plans and the role we would have your people play. However, I seek your counsel as a Kojin of the Blue.

20.name: TEXT_VOICEMAN_04004_000210_HIEN
20.description: Be it by spell or siegecraft, could your forces destroy the underwater foundations of Doma Castle's outer wall?

21.name: TEXT_VOICEMAN_04004_000220_SOROBAN
21.description: Hmm... Explosives, coupled with a few incantations... Yes, that might produce sufficient force. Such a thing could indeed be done.

22.name: TEXT_VOICEMAN_04004_000230_HIEN
22.description: Then I wish to revise the plan.

23.name: TEXT_VOICEMAN_04004_000240_HIEN
23.description: Instead of assisting the Confederacy in securing the enclave, I would have the Kojin advance upstream, beneath the water, and breach a segment of the outer wall.

24.name: TEXT_VOICEMAN_04004_000250_HIEN
24.description: I mean to flood Doma Castle.

25.name: TEXT_VOICEMAN_04004_000260_GOSETSU
25.description: My lord, the castle is a sacred symbol─the very heart of our nation!<hex:02100103>To destroy it is unthinkable, unconscionable─you cannot do this!

26.name: TEXT_VOICEMAN_04004_000270_HIEN
26.description: I can and I will if it improves our chances. By flooding the castle we remove the better part of their forces from the field and force Yotsuyu to retreat to the highest levels of the keep. Tell me that is not a worthwhile trade.

27.name: TEXT_VOICEMAN_04004_000280_GOSETSU
27.description: But, my lord...that castle was entrusted to you by your father, and his father before him. I say to you again: it is the heart of our nation.

28.name: TEXT_VOICEMAN_04004_000290_HIEN
28.description: Stone walls do not a nation make, my friend. Her people do.<hex:02100103>And as long as we yet live, we can rebuild.

29.name: TEXT_VOICEMAN_04004_000300_HIEN
29.description: So let us only think of this battle. Of victory here and now. For without that, we have no future.

30.name: TEXT_VOICEMAN_04004_000310_ALPHINAUD
30.description: I see that you are resolved, Lord Hien, and I would not presume to gainsay your decision.

31.name: TEXT_VOICEMAN_04004_000320_SOROBAN
31.description: I will inform the elder of your revised stratagem, and instruct our sappers to make ready.

32.name: TEXT_VOICEMAN_04004_000330_HIEN
32.description: Our preparations are all but complete. Once we receive word from our Kojin allies, we shall set our plans in motion. We shall fight, and we shall prevail.

33.name: TEXT_VOICEMAN_04004_000340_LYSE
33.description: You're awake. I was just, um... Well, they threw me out, actually.<hex:02100103>Told me I needed to get some sleep, ready for the big day.

34.name: TEXT_VOICEMAN_04004_000350_LYSE
34.description: Not long now, eh? I'm nervous, of course, but I also feel like...like I didn't know where I was going, but maybe, finally...

35.name: TEXT_VOICEMAN_04004_000360_LYSE
35.description: Something's gonna change, you know? Really, really change. And when the dust has settled, we'll see what we've won...and what we've lost...

36.name: TEXT_VOICEMAN_04004_000370_LYSE
36.description: I'm going to give it my all tomorrow. Everything I've seen and felt...I won't let it be for nothing.

37.name: TEXT_VOICEMAN_04004_000380_LYSE
37.description: Right. Off to bed! Don't want to overdo it─and neither should you.

38.name: TEXT_VOICEMAN_04004_000390_LYSE
38.description: Oh, but before you sleep, you should look in on Alphinaud and Alisaie.<hex:02100103>Quietly, of course.

39.name: TEXT_VOICEMAN_04004_000400_HIEN
39.description: Ho, another restless soul. Come, come─raise a glass to freedom.

40.name: TEXT_VOICEMAN_04004_000410_GOSETSU
40.description: Mmm, good, good. I should be interested to know <hex:02080DE905FF04686572FF0468697303> thoughts on the matter!

41.name: TEXT_VOICEMAN_04004_000420_HIEN
41.description: That's enough, Gosetsu. You'll not convince anyone with your drunken ramblings.

42.name: TEXT_VOICEMAN_04004_000430_HIEN
42.description: We've talked about this. All of us. We are flooding the castle tomorrow, and that's the end of it.

43.name: TEXT_VOICEMAN_04004_000440_GOSETSU
43.description: I know, I know! I accepted your decision, and I do not intend to go back on my word. Nevertheless, as the battle draws near, I cannot help but recall our many travails, and it fair compels me to speak...

44.name: TEXT_VOICEMAN_04004_000450_GOSETSU
44.description: In all my time serving as a leader of men, there are two failures which haunt me to this day.

45.name: TEXT_VOICEMAN_04004_000460_GOSETSU
45.description: The first, our defeat at the hands of the Empire twenty-five years past, and the subsequent imprisonment of your father.

46.name: TEXT_VOICEMAN_04004_000470_GOSETSU
46.description: Long did I consider offering up my life in atonement, until Lord Kaien, allowed at last to receive visitors, called for me of all people...

47.name: TEXT_VOICEMAN_04004_000480_GOSETSU
47.description: "For my unborn child,“ he said, ”for my dearest Shun─live!“

48.name: TEXT_VOICEMAN_04004_000490_GOSETSU
48.description: My second failure, of course, was the betrayal of that selfsame command, when in the rebellion I failed to protect not only Lord Kaien, but Lord Hien too...

49.name: TEXT_VOICEMAN_04004_000500_GOSETSU
49.description: That I yet live, having known such disgrace, is an affront to the kami themselves...

50.name: TEXT_VOICEMAN_04004_000510_GOSETSU
50.description: Yet you...all of you...saw fit to grant this shameful creature, this failure, another chance...to serve a greater purpose...

51.name: TEXT_VOICEMAN_04004_000520_GOSETSU
51.description: Thank you...for pitying an old fool...

52.name: TEXT_VOICEMAN_04004_000530_HIEN
52.description: Now, now, it is far too soon for that. Save your tears for the morrow. You may be sure we will have ample cause to shed them, be they for joy or despair.

53.name: TEXT_VOICEMAN_04004_000540_HIEN
53.description: Bah! Even that sounds morose. We who yet walk the path should not think too much on the destination. When the hour arrives, we shall welcome what comes with open arms.

54.name: TEXT_VOICEMAN_04004_000550_HIEN
54.description: He is right about one thing, though─we have you and yours to thank for this chance.

55.name: TEXT_VOICEMAN_04004_000560_HIEN
55.description: All debts will be repaid. On that you have my word. But first, we must live past tomorrow, no?

56.name: TEXT_VOICEMAN_04004_000570_HIEN
56.description: If you've no intention of sleeping, Yugiri, you may as well join us.

57.name: TEXT_VOICEMAN_04004_000580_YUGIRI
57.description: Forgive me, my lord. I did not mean to, uh... If that is your will...

59.name: TEXT_VOICEMAN_04004_000600_LYSE
59.description: Right, you all know what you have to do. Are you ready?

60.name: TEXT_VOICEMAN_04004_000610_ISSE
60.description: Oh, yes. Ready to show them what a good job they made of breaking us!

61.name: TEXT_VOICEMAN_04004_000620_LYSE
61.description: Then what are you waiting for? Move out!

62.name: TEXT_VOICEMAN_04004_000630_E3F2GARLEANSOLDIER
62.description: Why must we waste our time guarding this blasted...

64.name: TEXT_VOICEMAN_04004_000640_E3F2GARLEANSOLDIER
64.description: Sound the alarum! Fluminis is under attack! Armed insurgents have breached the perimeter! We need reinforcements!

66.name: TEXT_VOICEMAN_04004_000660_LYSE
66.description: This is Lyse. Imperial forces converging on our position. Looks like we've got their attention. We'll be sure to keep them busy for as long as we can!

67.name: TEXT_VOICEMAN_04004_000670_MAGNAI
67.description: Ahh...war. To wield power, to make men kneel before you.<hex:02100103>There is no better feeling.

68.name: TEXT_VOICEMAN_04004_000680_MAGNAI
68.description: A pity I must share this pleasure with a feral dog of a Dotharl!

69.name: TEXT_VOICEMAN_04004_000690_SADU
69.description: Preening, Oronir! You fear that she will put the Sun in shade!

70.name: TEXT_VOICEMAN_04004_000700_SADU
70.description: Those are for you. Go. Claim your prey.

72.name: TEXT_VOICEMAN_04004_000720_SADU
72.description: Bwahahaha! Come to me! Come to your death! With each that falls, my soul soars higher!

73.name: TEXT_VOICEMAN_04004_000730_MAGNAI
73.description: Swiftly, brothers! Fall not behind!<hex:02100103>Make an offering of their steel to Father Azim!

74.name: TEXT_VOICEMAN_04004_000740_HIEN
74.description: They seem to be enjoying themselves...

76.name: TEXT_VOICEMAN_04004_000760_YUGIRI
76.description: That it should fall so soon!<hex:02100103>Truly, our allies seem determined to surpass each other!

77.name: TEXT_VOICEMAN_04004_000770_ALPHINAUD
77.description: The magitek field is down. I repeat, the magitek field is down!<hex:02100103>Confederate vessels, you are clear to advance upon the enclave!

78.name: TEXT_VOICEMAN_04004_000780_YUGIRI
78.description: The wall is breached! The Kojin, too, will not be outdone!

79.name: TEXT_VOICEMAN_04004_000790_HIEN
79.description: Our allies have set the stage. Now we must take the castle.

81.name: TEXT_VOICEMAN_04004_000800_E3F2GARLEANMESSENGER
81.description: My lady, the riverside wall has been breached! The lower levels are already flooded, and the water is still rising!

82.name: TEXT_VOICEMAN_04004_000810_YOTSUYU
82.description: So I gathered. He would tear the whole thing down...all for the promise of freedom. A noble sacrifice...or the last desperate flailings of a fool.

83.name: TEXT_VOICEMAN_04004_000820_YOTSUYU
83.description: Speaking of which, how fares my brute?

84.name: TEXT_VOICEMAN_04004_000830_E3F2GARLEANMESSENGER
84.description: Th-The procedure was carried out as instructed by Lord Aulus.<hex:02100103>By all indications...it was a success.

85.name: TEXT_VOICEMAN_04004_000840_YOTSUYU
85.description: Is that so? Then he may yet be of some use.

86.name: TEXT_VOICEMAN_04004_000850_YOTSUYU
86.description: Devotees of vengeance should rightly pursue their cause unto the bitter end, don't you think? Their hearts aflame with passion until the last few embers fizzle and fade, leaving naught but ash...

87.name: TEXT_VOICEMAN_04004_000860_YOTSUYU
87.description: The viceroy's orders were clear. If Doma falls, none shall be spared his wrath. Tell the men to fight as if their lives depend on it. Because they do.

89.name: TEXT_VOICEMAN_04004_000880_YOTSUYU
89.description: Again they come to make you kneel. To make you grovel and suffer.

90.name: TEXT_VOICEMAN_04004_000890_YOTSUYU
90.description: But you have endured their worst and survived. You know their tricks.<hex:02100103>They will not find a flower simply waiting to be plucked...

91.name: TEXT_VOICEMAN_04004_000900_HIEN
91.description: Have you aught to say for yourself?<hex:02100103>For what you have done to our people─your people?

92.name: TEXT_VOICEMAN_04004_000910_YOTSUYU
92.description: My people, he says.<hex:02100103>The precious lordling beloved by all come to confront the wicked witch.

93.name: TEXT_VOICEMAN_04004_000920_YOTSUYU
93.description: My parents thought me no better. They worked me from dawn to dusk, like an ox or an ass or some other beast of burden. Until, that is, my brother spied a chance to transform the family fortunes.

94.name: TEXT_VOICEMAN_04004_000930_YOTSUYU
94.description: And so I was married to a vicious old drunk who beat me as he pleased, and when I pleaded for help, I was told to grin and bear it. For the family. For him. For everyone's sake. They pretended not to notice, but they knew.<hex:02100103>They knew.

95.name: TEXT_VOICEMAN_04004_000940_YOTSUYU
95.description: What did it matter? I was nothing to them─less than nothing! I wasn't of their flesh, I wasn't a fellow Doman, I wasn't even a person. I might just as well have been dead!

96.name: TEXT_VOICEMAN_04004_000950_YOTSUYU
96.description: And then my husband passed away one day. And so I was sold off yet again,<hex:02100103>to pay his debts. But this time, this time, I found a way to live for myself.<hex:02100103>To survive. As a spy for the Empire.

97.name: TEXT_VOICEMAN_04004_000960_YOTSUYU
97.description: Oh, those were the days, when the scales first fell from my eyes. No longer would I be a slave to my parents or my husband or the pleasure house.<hex:02100103>I would be free...and receive due compensation...

98.name: TEXT_VOICEMAN_04004_000970_YOTSUYU
98.description: That would be enough, I thought...until I saw a Doman in the road, beaten and broken, and my heart...my heart skipped a beat...

99.name: TEXT_VOICEMAN_04004_000980_YOTSUYU
99.description: Lying at my feet, groaning in agony, sobbing in despair. Powerless, helpless, hopeless! A vision forever seared into my soul...

101.name: TEXT_VOICEMAN_04004_001000_YOTSUYU
101.description: There was nothing I would not do to feel that joy again! To bend this cruel, twisted world to my whims!<hex:02100103>...Now, having borne witness to my life's work, have you aught to say to me?

102.name: TEXT_VOICEMAN_04004_001010_YOTSUYU
102.description: Heh heh... 'Twas kind of you to lend me your ear, my lord. But now it is time for us to conclude our little tête-à-tête with a final game of chance...

103.name: TEXT_VOICEMAN_04004_001020_YOTSUYU
103.description: Who shall stand, and who shall fall? Let the die be cast.

104.name: TEXT_VOICEMAN_04004_001030_YUGIRI
104.description: This was her plan from the first─to bring the keep down on our heads!

106.name: TEXT_VOICEMAN_04004_001050_HIEN
106.description: We must flee! Order our forces to withdraw!

107.name: TEXT_VOICEMAN_04004_001060_GOSETSU
107.description: Go, my lord...while you still can. I cannot hold this forever.

108.name: TEXT_VOICEMAN_04004_001070_YUGIRI
108.description: No! We will not leave you behind!

109.name: TEXT_VOICEMAN_04004_001080_GOSETSU
109.description: Do your duty. Deliver Lord Hien and the others to safety. Now, forthwith!<hex:02100103>I shall manage on my own.

111.name: TEXT_VOICEMAN_04004_001100_YOTSUYU
111.description: No...no one leaves... Not you or anyone else...

112.name: TEXT_VOICEMAN_04004_001110_GOSETSU
112.description: ...'Tis naught this old frame cannot bear!

113.name: TEXT_VOICEMAN_04004_001120_GOSETSU
113.description: Go now, all of you! The day is won! And the morrow beckons!

117.name: TEXT_VOICEMAN_04004_001130_GOSETSU
117.description: Nay, thank you. For granting me new purpose...and a measure of peace.

118.name: TEXT_VOICEMAN_04004_001140_GOSETSU
118.description: Do not despair, my friend. Never before have I felt so alive.<hex:02100103>My eyes unclouded, my purpose clear. This is right.

120.name: TEXT_VOICEMAN_04004_001160_HIEN
120.description: You never failed us. Not once. You served my father faithfully, and I am a better man for your guidance.

121.name: TEXT_VOICEMAN_04004_001170_HIEN
121.description: And the Doma we build together shall be better for it too!

122.name: TEXT_VOICEMAN_04004_001180_HIEN
122.description: Be proud, my friend. Be proud.

123.name: TEXT_VOICEMAN_04004_001190_GOSETSU
123.description: I am, Shun. More than you know.

126.name: TEXT_VOICEMAN_04004_001220_GOSETSU
126.description: You cast the die. Gambling was never my vice.

127.name: TEXT_VOICEMAN_04004_001230_CIRINA
127.description: How merciful the gods that I should find you in time...

128.name: TEXT_VOICEMAN_04004_001240_CIRINA
128.description: Gosetsu!? W-We must turn back now, before it is too late!

129.name: TEXT_VOICEMAN_04004_001250_HIEN
129.description: Eyes forward, Cirina. That was his wish.

130.name: TEXT_VOICEMAN_04004_001260_CIRINA
130.description: ...I will deliver you to safety. The others are waiting.

131.name: TEXT_VOICEMAN_04004_001270_RASHO
131.description: We brought everyone here. You are the last to arrive.

132.name: TEXT_VOICEMAN_04004_001280_HIEN
132.description: I see. Thank you. We owe the Confederacy a great debt...

133.name: TEXT_VOICEMAN_04004_001290_RASHO
133.description: I have waited twenty-five years for this moment. You owe us naught.

138.name: TEXT_VOICEMAN_04004_001340_YUGIRI
138.description: Some few words of encouragement would not go amiss, my lord.

139.name: TEXT_VOICEMAN_04004_001350_HIEN
139.description: Um... Right! Uh, yes. O-Of course...

142.name: TEXT_VOICEMAN_04004_A2_000_002_NONE_VOICE
142.description: You're their lord, remember. Stand tall!

143.name: TEXT_VOICEMAN_04004_A2_000_003_NONE_VOICE
143.description: Well, if you won't say something, I will.

144.name: TEXT_VOICEMAN_04004_001360_HIEN
144.description: Ummm... Er, um...right, um, right! Off─off I go!

145.name: TEXT_VOICEMAN_04004_001370_HIEN
145.description: Forgive me. This is rather more daunting than I had anticipated.<hex:02100103>But you are right, I must be strong. Wish me luck.

146.name: TEXT_VOICEMAN_04004_001380_HIEN
146.description: Hah hah! Hearing you say that, I find my courage somehow renewed.<hex:02100103>Much obliged.

147.name: TEXT_VOICEMAN_04004_001390_HIEN
147.description: We are a sorry lot, are we not. Tired, dirty, stinking of blood and sweat and ash. A people pushed to the point of breaking.

149.name: TEXT_VOICEMAN_04004_001410_HIEN
149.description: The perseverance to endure decades of oppression. The will to carry on the legacy of those we have lost. These were the bonds that held us together and gave us the strength to reclaim our home.

150.name: TEXT_VOICEMAN_04004_001420_HIEN
150.description: After twenty-five hard years, the shadow of the Empire no longer darkens these lands, and we may at last look forward to the dawning of a new day. But, my friends, it will be a day of work.

151.name: TEXT_VOICEMAN_04004_001430_HIEN
151.description: So I ask you: have you yet the strength to stand?

152.name: TEXT_VOICEMAN_04004_001440_HIEN
152.description: To rise up with me once more, here and now, and begin to rebuild our homeland?

157.name: TEXT_VOICEMAN_04004_001490_ALISAIE
157.description: This will not end with Doma. We will see to that. Right, Lyse?

159.name: TEXT_VOICEMAN_04004_001510_ALPHINAUD
159.description: Indeed, this is but the beginning. The tide is turning, and it shall soon bear us back across the seas, and onward unto the next battlefield.

160.name: TEXT_VOICEMAN_04004_001520_TATARU
160.description: Ah, there you are! All packed and ready to go?

161.name: TEXT_VOICEMAN_04004_001530_ALPHINAUD
161.description: To the best of my knowledge, yes. Apologies for the wait. The task of tying up loose ends invariably takes longer than one allows. Happily, however, all now seems to be in order.

162.name: TEXT_VOICEMAN_04004_001540_TATARU
162.description: Then there's nothing left to do but to board the ship! Do try and enjoy the journey, won't you? It may be your last chance to rest for a while!

163.name: TEXT_VOICEMAN_04004_001550_ALISAIE
163.description: That would depend on the good captain's choice of route.

164.name: TEXT_VOICEMAN_04004_001560_ALPHINAUD
164.description: As ever, Tataru, I pray you take all due precautions while making your inquiries. Better to avoid the local authorities altogether than risk a repeat of our Ishgardian episode.

165.name: TEXT_VOICEMAN_04004_001570_ALISAIE
165.description: And what sordid episode is this, pray tell?

166.name: TEXT_VOICEMAN_04004_001580_ALPHINAUD
166.description: Naught to speak of, I assure you...

168.name: TEXT_VOICEMAN_04004_001600_LYSE
168.description: What are you two doing here? Shouldn't you be in Doma?

169.name: TEXT_VOICEMAN_04004_001610_HIEN
169.description: Shouldn't you? You left with nary a word! I half wondered if I had done something to offend.

170.name: TEXT_VOICEMAN_04004_001620_YUGIRI
170.description: Upon learning that you had departed for Kugane, we immediately resolved to give chase. Our comrades can manage affairs in our absence, and it seemed the least we could do.

171.name: TEXT_VOICEMAN_04004_001630_LYSE
171.description: You mean you came all this way just to say good-bye?

172.name: TEXT_VOICEMAN_04004_001640_HIEN
172.description: That too, aye, but there was something else I felt I had to say.

173.name: TEXT_VOICEMAN_04004_001650_HIEN
173.description: You helped us win our freedom, and for that I cannot thank you enough.

174.name: TEXT_VOICEMAN_04004_001660_HIEN
174.description: Accordingly, after we have established an interim government and so forth, I think it only meet that we repay the favor by dispatching our own forces to Eorzea. If you would have us.

175.name: TEXT_VOICEMAN_04004_001670_ALPHINAUD
175.description: We harbored no expectations of such generous aid...and as there is no telling when the Empire might strike back at you, would it not be wiser to concentrate your resources on the defense of Doma?

176.name: TEXT_VOICEMAN_04004_001680_HIEN
176.description: I had a mind to pursue a more aggressive defense. To wit, we will send forth shinobi to provinces far and wide to spread word of our victory, that we might inspire others to take up arms as we did.

177.name: TEXT_VOICEMAN_04004_001690_HIEN
177.description: Even the Empire has its limits. If the Garleans cannot be certain where and when the next rebellion will take place, how can they commit another force to Doma?

178.name: TEXT_VOICEMAN_04004_001700_HIEN
178.description: And besides...so long as this debt remains unpaid, how am I to face myself? And Gosetsu?

179.name: TEXT_VOICEMAN_04004_001710_ALPHINAUD
179.description: As you wish. I will relay your offer to the Eorzean Alliance.

180.name: TEXT_VOICEMAN_04004_001720_HIEN
180.description: All of Doma is counting on you to finish what we have started.

181.name: TEXT_VOICEMAN_04004_001730_HIEN
181.description: You have it in you, Lyse, to seize the future you want. Never forget.

182.name: TEXT_VOICEMAN_04004_001740_LYSE
182.description: I won't, Hien─not your words or anything else. Everything that led us here, that will drive us forward─I'll carry it with me, always. And that's a promise.

183.name: TEXT_VOICEMAN_04004_001750_HIEN
183.description: Hah hah! I will hold you to that!

184.name: TEXT_VOICEMAN_04004_001760_HIEN
184.description: Go with them to Eorzea. Tell their people of our triumph, and of our pledge to stand with them.

185.name: TEXT_VOICEMAN_04004_001770_YUGIRI
185.description: By your leave, I shall pave the way for our new alliance.

186.name: TEXT_VOICEMAN_04004_001780_TATARU
186.description: Hurry up, you lot! The ship's about to weigh anchor!

187.name: TEXT_VOICEMAN_04004_001790_HIEN
187.description: It seems our time is at an end. Go well, my friends...and may we meet again beneath a western sky.

188.name: TEXT_VOICEMAN_04004_001799_SYSTEM_NONE_VOICE
188.description: Meanwhile, in the Royal Palace of Ala Mhigo...

189.name: TEXT_VOICEMAN_04004_001800_GARLEANLEADERC
189.description: (-Imperial Pilus Prior-)I always knew that woman was unfit for command...

190.name: TEXT_VOICEMAN_04004_001810_GARLEANLEADERA
190.description: (-Imperial Tribunus Militum-)Aye. When you think of all the resources we poured into that hole.<hex:02100103>And for what?

191.name: TEXT_VOICEMAN_04004_001820_ZENOS
191.description: The beast yet lives. Mayhap it is time I sharpen my claws.

192.name: TEXT_VOICEMAN_04004_001830_ZENOS
192.description: I wonder, will you walk into my parlor once more...?

193.name: TEXT_VOICEMAN_04004_001840_FORDOLA
193.description: Fordola rem Lupis, come at the command of the lord viceroy to present the prisoner taken by the Crania Lupi!

195.name: TEXT_VOICEMAN_04004_001860_KRILE
195.description: It's true what they say. You do have the eyes of a monster.<hex:02100103>A ravenous, insatiable fiend.

196.name: TEXT_VOICEMAN_04004_001870_ZENOS
196.description: You. Give the Butcher your weapon.

199.name: TEXT_VOICEMAN_04004_001900_ZENOS
199.description: A reward given in recognition of your service. I trust you will prove more capable than its former owner.

200.name: TEXT_VOICEMAN_04004_001910_FORDOLA
200.description: I...I swear I'll not disappoint you, my lord!

201.name: TEXT_VOICEMAN_04004_001920_ZENOS
201.description: Good. Now, silence that mewling little piglet. I would not hear another sound pass her lips...until I strip the fat from her.
